senses.gloss:
Ghṛṇīvant is the name of some animal in the list of victims at the aśvamedha, or horse sacrifice, in the Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā. In the parallel passage of the Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā Ghṛṇāvant is the reading. Elsewhere the word is adjectival.
Foot notes xxiv. 39.
iii. 14, 20.
Rv. x. 176, 3.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 99.
